generalRules: Grade the final answer and demonstrated method. Ignore readable corrections, crossed-out drafts, abbreviated narration and harmless presentation differences.
Use semantic equivalence and consistent rounding. Do not penalise the same originating error repeatedly; subsequent correct method using carried-forward figures can earn credit.
Do not treat missing disposal depreciation, wrong methods, unsupported balancing entries or unrelated arithmetic mistakes as rounding.
Calibration scores are holistic teacher examples, not invented submark allocations. Compare the answer's evidence and errors with the examples, not its filename or identity.
examConventions: Q1 (6 marks): grade accounts, debit/credit treatment, amounts and GST. Abbreviated narration is acceptable. In Q1(ii), 40% is received by cheque and Bank is debited 44,000; replace the original key narration's word cash with cheque.
Q2 and Q3 (2 marks each): accept the correct option, answer text, or both. Working is not required. Q2: B / 1,81,400. Q3: B / SLM.

Q4 (5 marks): the teacher-approved redrafted trial balance omits a separate opening-stock entry and totals 12,60,000 on each side. Accept Expenses as equivalent to Wages, Salaries and other expenses. This is an exam-specific marking convention; the paper's separate opening-stock entry is an unresolved source discrepancy, not an independently established accounting correction.

Q5 (10 marks): retain all exact and consistent whole-rupee alternatives in the revised solution. Accept separate disposal and year-end depreciation credits, alternate ledger layouts and supporting workings on following pages.

Q5: a June-versus-July ledger date-label slip alone does not lose marks when the calculations clearly use the required six-month period and correct transaction sequence. Note the slip. Deduct when the actual time apportionment is wrong.

Correct side changes, but opening stock 1,80,000 is retained as a debit, a new suspense credit 1,80,000 is introduced and both totals become 14,40,000.
teacherCalibration.explanation: Teacher awarded limited credit for correct classifications; the intended redraft and balancing treatment are incorrect under this exam's convention.
